verdict.rationale: Ramp documents several of its own configurable, event-triggered automations. These include dynamic approval routing with parallel workflows, a customizable human-in-the-loop policy for agents ('auto-approve the routine, hold what matters'), and auto top-up with target-balance thresholds and low-balance alerts. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rule builder (if-event-then-action), and webhooks are only a developer building block for constructing such logic externally. missing for 10: documented general-purpose rule/workflow builder with arbitrary event triggers and actions, docs on rule configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
